detected_fault: Intermittent shutdowns when running on battery and right before Windows sign-in screen.
suggested_solution: Check and replace the battery if its capacity is below 80%
Verify that all drivers are up-to-date, especially GPU and CPU drivers.
Set power limit on CPU to 60W to reduce heat generation.
Use only Dell-provided drivers and avoid Windows updates for drivers.
Monitor system logs for any error messages related to the shutdowns.
